derived_from.operation: generate an aligned castle/rampart/rail/platform overlay with transparent empty regions.

purpose: Near BG_A architecture and fighting-platform overlay concept with alpha; not native Mega Drive art.
prompt: Create the aligned NEAR/MIDGROUND overlay plate from this original Suzaku Castle fighting-stage panorama, keeping exactly the same full-width coordinates and scale as the reference. Isolate only the Japanese castle towers, connecting ramparts, foreground roof/wooden railing, lanterns, and stone fighting platform. Keep castle main tower centered at world x=320, castle top near y=60, railing around y=150, and the walkable floor around y=176..224 in a 640x224 Mega Drive playfield. Remove all moon, clouds, mountains, sky and distant forest. Everywhere outside the isolated architecture and platform must be a perfectly uniform flat saturated magenta RGB #FF00FF key color with no texture, gradient, shadow, checkerboard or outline; do not use this magenta in the art itself. Preserve the full panoramic canvas; do not crop or move objects. Crisp grouped 16-bit pixel-art, strong silhouettes and limited material clusters, warm lit windows/lanterns, no fighters, no HUD, no text, no labels, no new architecture, no pseudo-3D. This is a staging matte source for a future compositing test, not a final hardware asset.

observed_output.note: Image generation returned true alpha transparency although the prompt requested a uniform magenta key.
